headline: Vegas Casino Chain Rewards 10,000 Workers With $70M Stock Bonus
meta_description: Station Casinos surprised its 10,000 employees with $70 million in stock bonuses for the company's 50th anniversary, giving $1,000 per year of service.
summary_short: On its 50th anniversary, Station Casinos announced a stunning $70 million gift: $1,000 in company stock for every year each of its 10,000 employees has worked there.
body:
When Station Casinos' 10,000 employees gathered at one of the company's resorts to celebrate its 50th anniversary, they were expecting a typical corporate event. Instead, they witnessed something rare: business leaders Frank Fertitta III and Lorenzo Fertitta announced that every worker would receive a bonus of $1,000 in company stock for each year on the payroll—a total gift of $70 million. The move reflected founder Frank Fertitta Jr.'s original mission to serve the community and, most crucially, to take care of team members.

The impact was immediate and profound. Ida Johnson, who joined the company in 1977, received $49,000 worth of stock that will generate approximately $886 annually in dividends. Paula Barrett, with 47 years of service, called receiving her bonus "a complete honor," explaining that she had stayed because "we're all comfortable. This is home for us. We love it here." Seven employees have been with Station Casinos for 45 years or longer—a remarkable testament to workplace loyalty in an industry often marked by high turnover.

What makes this moment significant isn't just the scale of the gift, but what it reveals about how the Fertitta brothers view their workforce. In a business landscape where profit-sharing announcements are uncommon, they chose to invest directly in the people who built their company. The decision honors not just current contributions, but decades of commitment. For employees like those who arrived in 1976 at the original Bingo Palace location, this bonus recognizes a lifetime of service to the company's growth.
quick_facts: 10,000 Station Casinos employees received $1,000 stock per year of service
Total bonus package: $70 million distributed on 50th anniversary
Seven employees have worked there 45+ years; one joined in 1977
Paula Barrett's 47-year tenure made her eligible for substantial payout
Fertitta brothers honored founder's principle to 'take care of our team members'
